Water stains and sagging drywall in two upstairs bedroom ceilings; attic insulation saturated over roughly a 3 m by 4 m area under the rear roof slope. The insured's handyman had cut out a section of decking in mid-March to fit a new bathroom vent fan and covered the hole with a plastic sheet held by a few battens pending the roofer's return; the sheet had pulled loose at one edge and rain had been getting in each time it rained for about three weeks. No plumbing involvement; supply lines and HVAC checked and dry. Insured cooperative, photos on file.
